dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge exhibiting high falcation with a deep parabolic arc from the posterior base to the sub-apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a small-radius rounded tip forming the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin oriented at approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the visible longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Longitudinal base-to-height ratio of approximately 0.85:1, where vertical height exceeds horizontal base width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear rake marks/scars visible on the mid-to-lower lateral surface of the dorsal fin; slight irregularity on the leading edge near the lower third.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent specular reflections and surface water ripples creating high-contrast patterns across the visible dermal layer.
